prompt: RimWorld creature sprite of the Star Wars canon loth-cat, as the live-action puppet from the Ahsoka series. One animal, whole body, centred. Realistic live-action creature: dense, soft, fluffy pale cream-to-oatmeal fur over a plump rounded body, sparse dark brown spots on the flanks and tall ears; two very tall upright pointed ears with tufted tips and dark spot markings, pinkish-grey inner ear; broad flat face with a wide closed frog-like mouth and heavy drooping lips/jowls, pale chin pouch, small round black eyes set wide, a small flat nose; whiskers; a bushy fluffy tail carried up; thin dark grey scaly bird-like legs with long clawed toes, contrasting with the fluffy body. Warm natural light, soft photographic realism -- plush fur, no outlines, no cartoon gloss, no reptile skin. Follow the canon Must show list exactly.
